b: Friedman Amplification has introduced the VX Series, part of Dave Friedman’s Vintage Series. It’s inspired by the British EL84 amplifiers of the early 1960s and includes three products: the VX-30 30-watt all-tube head, the VX-30 2x12 combo, and the matching VX-212 extension cabinet.
The VX-30 runs on four EL84 power tubes. It’s based on a rare 1963 copper-panel amplifier fitted with a Top Boost circuit.

Handcrafted in Los Angeles, the VX-30 Head and Combo each have two independent channels. The Brilliant channel has Treble, Bass, and Volume controls and covers clean through edge-of-breakup tones. The Normal channel has a Volume control and a three-position Voice switch that recreates the three factory voicings of the vintage originals. Treble gives open cleans, Bass adds low end and body, and Normal is warmer.

The original amps didn’t run their channels in phase. The VX-30 does, so the channels can be blended, similar to jumping the inputs on a Plexi. Players can also use each channel on its own. Friedman suggests running a treble booster into the Normal channel and blending in the Brilliant channel for added definition.
A Cut control shapes the power amp’s high-frequency response. The M.V.C. (Master Volume Control) lets players push the cathode-biased EL84 output stage at lower volumes.

The VX-30 uses cathode bias, a 5AR4 tube rectifier, and zero negative feedback, so it cleans up as the guitar’s volume is rolled back. There’s no standby switch because the 5AR4 rectifier warms up gradually, which gives the amp a natural soft start. Friedman says the amp also includes modern protection features and conservatively rated components.

The VX-30 Combo is loaded with two Celestion Alnico Blue speakers. The open-back VX-212 cabinet is designed to pair with the VX-30 Head. It’s built from tongue-and-groove Baltic birch, has two Celestion Alnico Blue 12" speakers, and is wired with oversized 12-gauge speaker wire.
All three products are available in Black or Vintage Ivory, are handcrafted in the USA, and are backed by Friedman’s Limited Lifetime Warranty.
VX-30 Head and Combo Features Include:
Cathode-biased power section with zero negative feedback
Two independent channels operating in phase for blending
Brilliant channel: Volume, Treble, and Bass
Normal channel: Volume and three-position Voice switch (Treble, Normal, Bass)
Cut control for power-amp high-frequency shaping
Three speaker outputs: 1 x 16 Ω, plus paired outputs for 1 x 8 Ω or 2 x 16 Ω cabinets
Combo: 2 x Celestion Alnico Blue speakers

The Friedman VX-30 combo is available for a street price of $3,599.99. The VX-30 head carries a street price of $2,799.99. The VX-212 extension cabinet is priced at $1,499.99. For more information, visit https://friedmanamplification.com/.
